findings.title: A byte-for-byte copy of TCB files exempts a user package from admission
findings.resolution: Trust is now (import path, file name, digest): sgoadmit.Trusted(pkgpath, files) requires a TCB package path and each file's manifest entry (shared tcbFileOK with CheckTCB); the content-only digest set is no longer generated. The importer refuses a 'tcb' identity on a non-TCB path (SGO_E_FOREIGN_OBJECT), and so does the linker (sgoIdentConfigErr, generated sgotcb.go list). policy.md reworded. SGO-TCB-002 clause wording ('a function of file digests') is deferred to the version change of SR2, since it is normative text.
findings.regression_test: test-tcb.py copy cases (subset copy of internal/stringslite, whole internal/godebugs, direct compile; digest asserted first); host-lane TestTrusted and TestSGoIdentConfigErr; mutation (content-only Trusted) caught by test-tcb via the importer check

findings.title: S-Go programs honour GODEBUG, GOTRACEBACK, GOGC, GOMEMLIMIT and GOMAXPROCS
Shipped compile and link accept the whole upstream flag table for S-Go code
Dir.Open/Create on a FIFO wedges the program; the drain budget never fires
A captured named result is reassigned by return <operands>
findings.resolution: sgoAssignments treats a return with operands as assigning every named result of its innermost enclosing function (FuncDecl or FuncLit, tracked with a stack during Inspect) and reports SGO_E_CAPTURE_NOT_FINAL at the return when one is captured. A bare return still assigns nothing. ctl-defer-assigns-named-result now also expects the diagnostic at 'return 1, 2', which is correct per SGO-MEM-002 (the deferred literal captures b and the return assigns it). Recording the implicit-assignment forms in SGO-MEM-002 compile_link_checks is normative text, deferred to the SR2 version change (doc item D-R5).
findings.regression_test: conformance mem-capture-named-result-return (FuncDecl), mem-capture-named-result-return-literal (FuncLit), mem-capture-named-result-bare-return (run, exit 0); ctl-return-operands-nursery unchanged

findings.title: File confinement: Create truncates before the chain check; Mkdir/Remove act on a parent descriptor after verifying it (TOCTOU)
Running build scripts dirties tracked evidence files
Driver reuses cached TCB archives on a 'complete' marker alone; SGO_CACHE unclassified

self_findings.claim: Matrix status fields record what ran
self_findings.finding: 17 cases (I01-I07, T01-T06, T08, S01, S15, S19) had executed '<WP>: passed' evidence from their last required work package (W09/W10) but still had implementation_status pending / execution_status unrun. The W09 and W10 closures appended evidence without flipping the status fields.
self_findings.resolution: Flipped only cases whose last required work package has a '<WP>: passed' evidence entry (checked by the script that made the change). T07 stays pending (PARTIAL, D82). guarantee-check.py (D76) will fail on the inconsistency in either direction.

self_findings.claim: Q04: every accepted feature is explicit in the closed registry
self_findings.finding: The registry still carries its 0.1.0 text ('No row is admitted') and every implemented family is 'specified_not_admitted' with empty admitted_in and evidence, although W03-W10 implemented, enforced and tested them. The registry understates what the toolchain accepts. Row status is part of the admission digest, so correcting it moves every identity.

self_findings.claim: Each frozen clause records where it is implemented and what ran
self_findings.finding: 62 frozen clauses still said 'none yet' in their progress fields although implemented and tested in W02-W10. These fields are excluded from clause digests, so the text was stale but no identity was wrong.
self_findings.resolution: sgo/scripts/fill-progress.py filled the fields from the work packages already named, the family's implementation files, the clause's own fixtures, and the work-package evidence READMEs. No digest changed (spec-tool update leaves SGO_SPEC_ADMISSION.json untouched). guarantee-check.py fails if any frozen clause says 'none yet'.

self_findings.location: 76 added files: sgo/model, sgo/scripts, sgo/bench, sgo/examples
self_findings.claim: Every file added by S-Go carries the S-Go BSD header (D81)
self_findings.finding: 76 added source files (model, scripts, benchmarks, and the shipped examples) had no license header. LICENSE/PATENTS and vendored code were unchanged, no foreign license or copyright marker was found, and no upstream header was removed.
self_findings.resolution: license-audit.py --fix inserted the header (after any #! line). Model tests, test-fmt (354 files) and test-examples (pipeline, service, replay) pass afterwards. No TCB file changed. license-audit.py runs in sgo-spec CI.
self_findings.regression_test: license-audit.py (mutation: LICENSE edit, SPDX marker, missing header all caught)
